description: Verify that TCP progresses to ESTABLISHED after receiving SYN,ACK in SYN-SENT (RFC 793 §3.2 p23 Terminology)
approach:
[Objective]
The second leg of the active-OPEN handshake: SYN-SENT → ESTABLISHED on receiving SYN,ACK and emitting the third-leg ACK.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT in SYN-SENT after active OPEN.
2. Tester → DUT: SYN,ACK.
3. Observation: DUT → Tester: ACK and DUT in ESTABLISHED   ← key check

[Pass condition]
DUT reports ESTABLISHED after the third-leg ACK.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_not_established — DUT did not reach ESTABLISHED
• Fail_timeout — no DUT ACK within the listen window

verdicts.Pass: DUT reached ESTABLISHED on SYN,ACK — normal
verdicts.Fail_timeout: No DUT ACK within listen window
